gloss: cancellation; discontinuation; termination; ending (of a series)

definitions.explanation: bringing something to an end before its natural conclusion, often prematurely; commonly used for TV shows, manga series, and projects being cancelled

examples.japanese: ⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{低視聴率|ていしちょうりつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}りになった。
examples.english: The drama was cancelled due to low ratings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まった→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: It was decided to end the serialization early.

examples.japanese: {資金不足|しきんぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The project will be terminated due to lack of funds.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{打|う}つ→打つ：01221_utsu⟧ (to strike) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) → to cut off, discontinue
- ⟦{打|う}ち{切|き}る→打ち切る：06702_uchikiru⟧ (to cancel, discontinue)
- {打|う}ち{切|き}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to be cancelled)

USAGE:
- ⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}り (TV program cancellation)
- ⟦{連載|れんさい}→連載：14320_rensai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}り (manga/novel serialization cancellation)
- ⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}り (project termination)
- ⟦{補助|ほじょ}→補助：14105_hojo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}り (subsidy cutoff)
- ⟦{支援|しえん}→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{打|う}ち{切|き}り (support termination)
In manga, {打|う}ち{切|き}り means a series ended by the publisher before its planned ending, often with a rushed conclusion.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{中止|ちゅうし}→中止：03481_chuushi⟧ (calling off): cancels something planned or in progress, such as an event or a game. {打|う}ち{切|き}り cuts off something ongoing (a series, talks, support) before its natural end.
- ⟦{完結|かんけつ}→完結：12279_kanketsu⟧ (completion): the planned, natural ending; the opposite of {打|う}ち{切|き}り for a series.
- ⟦{廃止|はいし}→廃止：12483_haishi⟧ (abolition): ends a system or rule permanently.
